description: Fictional LinkedIn-style snapshots for the Job Seeker public demo. Every company and listing is invented; the numeric IDs are deliberately outside LinkedIn's current range. The policy mirrors the demo workspace's search settings.

policy.candidate_summary: Fictional design programme leader with 11 years of experience in design programmes, design operations, portfolio planning, research operations and service design.

snapshot.title: Design Operations Lead
snapshot.description:
Fernhill Commons Studio is a fictional product studio used in the Job Seeker public demo. We are hiring a Design Operations Lead to run the operating rhythm for four product design teams: quarterly planning, portfolio reporting, research operations and onboarding. You will partner with design, research and engineering leaders and report to the Head of Design.

Location: London, United Kingdom. Hybrid: three days a week in our London office.
Working language: English.

What you bring: several years leading design operations or design programmes across multiple teams; facilitation of planning and prioritisation; clear executive communication; experience improving how designers and researchers work together.

This is a fictional listing for automated testing.

reference.reason: A design operations leadership role in London on a hybrid schedule, in English, matching the candidate's design programme and operations experience.

snapshot.title: Design Program Manager
snapshot.description:
Kestrel Yard Labs is a fictional robotics company used in the Job Seeker public demo. Our Design Program Manager coordinates delivery across industrial design, interaction design and research, owns the design roadmap and runs programme reviews with engineering.

This role is fully on-site in our Berlin office five days a week. We do not offer hybrid or remote work for this position.
Working language: English.

This is a fictional listing for automated testing.

reference.reason: The role fits, but it is fully on-site in Berlin, outside the configured London and Amsterdam hybrid locations, and remote work is not offered.

snapshot.title: Junior Brand Production Coordinator
snapshot.description:
Lanternfish Creative is a fictional brand agency used in the Job Seeker public demo. This junior, entry-level role coordinates print and video production schedules for brand campaigns, books suppliers and tracks deliverables. It is a production-only position with no programme leadership, design operations or service design responsibilities.

Location: London, United Kingdom. Hybrid: two days a week in the studio.
Working language: English.

This is a fictional listing for automated testing.

reference.reason: A junior, production-only brand coordination role, not a design programme, design operations or service design leadership role.

snapshot.title: Principal Service Designer
snapshot.description:
Orchard Relay Health is a fictional digital health provider used in the Job Seeker public demo. Our Principal Service Designer will lead end-to-end service design for patient onboarding, connecting research, operations and product teams, and coach a small group of service designers.

This is a remote role within Europe. The countries we can employ in are still being confirmed and will be shared by the recruiter.
Working language: English.

This is a fictional listing for automated testing.

reference.reason: A strong role match, but the listing does not say which countries are eligible for this remote role, so location eligibility is uncertain.
